item.title: Lyse Doucet: Under fragile ceasefire, Iranians wonder if US deal can be done
item.summary: The BBC's chief international correspondent reports from Iran as diplomatic efforts to avoid a return to war intensify.

item.title: Frank Gardner: What is China's role in the Iran war?
item.summary: BBC Security Correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the world's second-largest economy fits into the Gulf conflict.

item.title: Israeli triple-tap strike kills three paramedics in Lebanon, officials say
item.summary: Lebanon's government condemns as a "flagrant crime" the killing of the paramedics, one of whom featured in a BBC report.

item.title: Sri Lanka repatriates 238 Iranian sailors stranded after US torpedo attack
item.summary: The survivors of the US attack on Iranian vessel Iris Dena, which claimed the lives of 104 people, were among those sent home.

item.title: 'Bit of pain' worth long-term security from Iran, Bessent tells BBC
item.summary: US Treasury Secretary said a "small bit of economic pain" was worth it to eliminate the threat of Iranian strikes on Western capitals.

item.title: Chinese national given one year in prison for smuggling ants out of Kenya
item.summary: Zhang Kequn was arrested in March while trying to travel to China with more than 2,000 live ants.

item.title: Nine killed in second Turkish school shooting in two days
item.summary: Eight students and one teacher died in the attack, according to Interior Minister Mustafa Cifci.

item.title: Ticketmaster-owner Live Nation ran a monopoly and overcharged fans, jury finds
item.summary: The lawsuit said the firm's practices had led to higher ticket prices and worse service for customers.

item.title: Former US Marine pilot loses appeal against extradition from Australia
item.summary: Daniel Duggan was arrested in 2022 over claims he illegally trained the Chinese military in South Africa.

item.title: Prominent Palestinian prisoner Marwan Barghouti assaulted three times in a month, family says
item.summary: The Israeli Prison Service says the allegation that Barghouti was subjected to physical violence by prison guards are "false and baseless".
